UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information, settings, and streak metrics

dailyGoalMinutes.description: Daily learning time target in minutes

lastActiveDate.description: Last active practice date in YYYY-MM-DD format

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily practice reminder is turned on

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the user's device (e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), used to send the daily reminder at local time

lastReminderSentDate.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) the last FCM daily reminder was sent. Written by Cloud Functions only

PracticeRecord.title: PracticeRecord
PracticeRecord.description: Individual pronunciation evaluation and phoneme analysis record

targetText.description: The phrase or sentence targeted for pronunciation

fluencyScore.description: Fluency and rhythm score out of 100

mispronouncedWords.description: Serialized list or details of mispronounced segments

tongueMouthAdvice.description: Guide on tongue and mouth placement for errors

assessmentId.description: M4 attempt id (pronunciation_attempts/{id}) to reopen the detailed phoneme analysis

scoringSource.description: api | gemini | ruleBased: which engine scored this session

DailyStat.title: DailyStat
DailyStat.description: Daily summary of practice time and progress towards goals

minutesSpent.description: Total practice minutes on this day

averageScore.description: Average pronunciation score for the day

FcmToken.title: FcmToken
FcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token of one device; document ID equals the token

token.description: FCM registration token (same as document ID)

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the device when the token was saved

updatedAt.description: Last time the token was refreshed

PronunciationAttempt.title: PronunciationAttempt
PronunciationAttempt.description: M4 assessment written by the Pronunciation API (Admin SDK); same shape as the API response

scores.description: pronunciation, accuracy, fluency, completeness (0-100), prosody (0-100 or null)

words.description: word, ipa, accuracy, errorType, isError, phonemes[expected, actual, accuracy, isError, errorKind, pattern, position]

feedback.description: priority, kind, target, messageVi, messageEn, minimalPair, practiceWords, exerciseIds

PhonemeStat.title: PhonemeStat
PhonemeStat.description: Per-user aggregate accuracy for one phoneme (doc id = ARPAbet, e.g. TH)

/users/{userId}.description: User profile with streak, goals, and reminder settings

/users/{userId}/practice_records/{record.description: User speech practice history and phoneme evaluation reports

/users/{userId}/daily_stats/{dateId}.description: Daily progress statistics for streak and time tracking

/users/{userId}/fcm_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Push notification tokens for the user's devices, read by the sendDailyReminders Cloud Function

/users/{userId}/pronunciation_attempts/{.description: M4 assessments, server-written, read-only for the owner

/users/{userId}/phoneme_stats/{phonemeId.description: Weakest phonemes per user, server-written, read-only for the owner
